synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a raised adjusted-EBITDA guide and subscriber inflection sit against a −77% year, −$107.8M FCF, and a −37% consensus EBITDA cut.

bull_points.claim: Adjusted-EBITDA guidance for fiscal 2026 was RAISED at the Q3 print to $90M–$100M (from an $80M–$100M band), management reaffirming the ≥$300M fiscal-2028 target — a step-up, not a cut, on the metric management steers.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Guidance (latest guide + sign-aware delivery track-record) — CIQ states every guide as a LEVEL; where management guided a RATE, the level is CIQ's arithmetic, not the company's published figure

bull_points.claim: A contractual wholesale-fee step-up (95% of Hulu+Live TV carriage costs in calendar 2026 scaling to 99% by 2028) gives a mechanical, non-speculative path to adjusted-EBITDA expansion — the causal driver behind the raised guide.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, May 06, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Subscribers turned positive: North America reached 5.75M in Q3, up 2% YoY vs the prior 5.7M-vs-5.9M decline a quarter earlier — the volume trend inflected from shrinking to growing after the Hulu+Live TV combination.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Advertising monetization is improving on a validated basis — double-digit YoY increases in CPM and fill rates since migrating inventory to the Disney ad server, a fresh margin lever independent of subscriber count.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: ESPN 'Where to Watch' referrals are converting free-trial-to-paid at a higher rate than other channels with favourable early retention — a low-cost acquisition channel tied to a >100M-monthly-user ecosystem.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The reverse merger with Disney's Hulu+Live TV closed Oct-29-2025, roughly tripling revenue (FY25 $4,413M → LTM $5,712M) and giving Disney a 70% stake — a structural scale change, not organic drift.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Key Developments: FuboTV Inc NYSE FUBO Key Developments.rtf · Oct-29-2025

bull_points.claim: Sell-side stance is constructive: mean/median target $17.00 versus a $10.27 close, with 5 Buy / 3 Outperform / 2 Hold ratings and no Sell.

bear_points.claim: The stock fell 76.7% over the trailing year while its small-cap benchmark rose ~34% — an idiosyncratic collapse, not a market drag.
bear_points.source_ref: EOD FUBO vs IWM rebased to 100, 2025-08-15..2026-08-14

bear_points.claim: The business is deeply cash-consumptive: LTM levered FCF is −$107.8M and CFO for the twelve months to Sep-27-2025 is −$456M, so the raised adjusted-EBITDA guide is NOT the real signal on survival — actual cash out the door is the load-bearing fact, and it is negative.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [12 months Sep-27-2025]

bear_points.claim: Current-FY consensus has deteriorated sharply — FY26 EBITDA revised from $150M (9m ago) to $95.2M (net −37%) and GAAP EPS crossed from +1.68 to −1.21 — so the raised company adjusted-EBITDA guide diverges from a falling street EBITDA path, the divergence itself a warning that 'adjusted' and reported are drifting apart.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

bear_points.claim: Near-term revision breadth is overwhelmingly negative — FQ4 2026 Revenue 0↑/8↓ and EBITDA 0↑/7↓ across all lookbacks — signalling estimates are still being cut into the next print.

The reported EBITDA-margin optic is thin and the reconciler confirms it is genuinely low, not an artefact: LTM revenue $5,712M carries only a 6% gross margin, and consensus FY26 EBITDA margin is ~2% — a real signal, not a percentage falling while absolute EBITDA rises.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: The share count is diluting (~+2.5% over ~0.7yr) against an active S-3ASR shelf and repeated S-8 filings, adding per-share pressure while the company burns cash.

Leadership turnover is concurrent with the de-rate: co-founder David Gandler resigned from the board and a new Disney-sourced CEO took over effective Jul-10-2026, with the co-founder COO also transitioning to an advisory role.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Key Developments: FuboTV Inc NYSE FUBO Key Developments.rtf · Jul-09-2026
